grammar_errors.mistake: He used masculine عيان for his fiancée; Amal echoed the feminine عيانة (02:00 and 02:23) and he took it ('Yeah, Ayana').
grammar_errors.said: Ayan, Ayan is sick. / خطيبتي, شوي, Ayan.

grammar_errors.mistake: Amal recast his order (verb with -ha before راسها) to راسها بيوجع twice and he repeated it back ('He rasa biwaja').
He reached for لـ for 'worried about fire'; Amal said worried takes من ('Men, men') and he said من نار.
grammar_errors.fix: You're worried about. You're worried from. ... Men، men.

grammar_errors.mistake: Missing على after دير بال (Amal 11:45 'بدير بالي takes على') and missing -i on بال; her recast بالي على خطيبتي. He repeated the على-less form at 11:35 (same slip, one row).
Asked for another example he produced ديري باليك; Amal gave دير بالك and named it as the command form (and بالك, not باليك).
grammar_errors.fix: دير بالك is actually the command form.

grammar_errors.mistake: After خلينا the verb is a bare present; he used past عملنا, Amal said نعمل and he repeated it.
غير takes the bare noun; Amal recast without el- (again 20:30) and he asked 'قير never takes...'.
grammar_errors.said: قير الشمس و اليوم شو، شو في.

grammar_errors.mistake: سما needs el- (السما) and comes first; Amal recast السما بالليل and he repeated 'الـ سما بي الليل'.
grammar_errors.said: بس في الـ، الـ، الليل سما. في الليل سما،

grammar_errors.bucket_name: taani: before or after the noun
grammar_errors.mistake: noun + taani = another, agrees in gender: نجمة is feminine so تانية; Amal echoed تاني and he fixed to تانية.
Fronted object (هذي أول نجمة) needs the pointer ending; Amal prompted and he said بشوفها ('I forgot the pointer').
'Different from' takes عن; he used من and Amal said عن twice; he then said 'بيد and (عن) الهاوا هناك'.
grammar_errors.said: آآ، بيد من because it's comparative, right?

grammar_errors.bucket_name: aa5er / a5eer: before or after the noun
grammar_errors.mistake: aa5er + el- = 'the end of'; for 'the last time' it is آخر مرة, Amal explained and he took it.
grammar_errors.fix: آخر المرة means the last of the time. The end of the time. ... آخر مرة. The last time.

grammar_errors.mistake: Subject مرة is feminine so kaan must be كانت; Amal prompted 'مرة is' and he said 'feminine. كانت'.
Amal recast the past form with vowels (tallajat) after his تلجات; may be only pronunciation of the doubled ل (S4) - she had said ممتاز at 35:27.
Object 'me' rides on the verb (-ni); he said English 'me', Amal recast النار حرقتني.
grammar_errors.said: El nar, nar heret me. Does that count correct?

grammar_errors.mistake: 'I cleaned it' needs the -ha ending; Amal prompted 'It.' and he said 'Nadabet ha', she recast نظفتها.
He meant the streets (plural; شارع is masc so قديمة did not fit); Amal recast الشوارع and he repeated it.
'The streets (in Amsterdam) are stone' takes no verb in Arabic; he built 'were made (of) stone' with عملت and Amal said just حجر: الشوارع ... حجر.
grammar_errors.fix: Or just حجر. Are stone. ... Made of is different than made. ... الشوارع الإدام في أمريكا حجر.

grammar_errors.bucket_name: taani: before or after the noun
grammar_errors.mistake: For 'the second stone' taani goes before the noun (or الحجر التاني); حجر تاني means 'another stone'. Amal recast and he said تاني حجر.
grammar_errors.fix: تاني حجر or الحجر التاني. You said it first right.

grammar_errors.mistake: 'My favorite' standing alone is المفضل عندي (adjective with el-); he said مفضل لي, Amal gave المفضل عندي and prompted 'الـ' again at 54:25 when he repeated مفضل عندي.
grammar_errors.fix: So you could either say my favorite stone or my favorite using عندي. المفضل عندي. ... الـ، المفضل عندي.

grammar_errors.mistake: Adjective مفضل goes after the noun; Amal named it ('المفضل is an adjective') and gave الحجر المفضل.
grammar_errors.said: I was gonna say الـ مفضل حجر.
grammar_errors.fix: الحجر المفضل or حجري المفضل. المفضل is an adjective.

grammar_errors.mistake: A noun with a possessive ending takes no el-; Amal: 'حجري المفضل. No ال first.'
Again 'my favorite' without el-; Amal named the rule (al-mufaddal is an adjective, follows ders) and gave هاد الدرس المفضل عندي. New sentence 4 min after 54:09, so a separate row.
grammar_errors.fix: But al-mufaddal is an adjective, so it follows ders. ... هاد الدرس المفضل عندي.

grammar_errors.mistake: He used في ('there is') as 'is' in 'isn't here' (engine likely merged في هون into فيهن); Amal: 'مش في. مش هون ... في is not is', and he took it ('مش هون. Okay, you're right').
grammar_errors.fix: مش هون. مش، مش في. مش هون. ... في is not is. في is there is.
